fullDescription: A classic single-column authentication layout with vertically stacked inputs and actions. Optimized for clarity and speed, this layout guides the user top-to-bottom with minimal cognitive load and works well for fast login scenarios.
prompt:
## Resumo
A minimalist wireframe UI style utilizing a white background, sharp black borders, and high-contrast typography. It combines Satoshi for headlines with JetBrains Mono for utility text, creating a clean, technical, and structured user experience without shadows or rounded corners.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a pure white background (#FFFFFF) and high-contrast elements in Gray-900 (#111827). 
- Typography: Primary font 'Satoshi' (Weight 700 for headings, 400/500 for main text). Secondary font 'JetBrains Mono' (Weight 400, 12px, uppercase with tracking-wider) for labels and technical data. 
- Borders: Use 1px solid Gray-300 (#D1D5DB) for inactive states and 2px solid Gray-900 (#111827) for active or primary actions. No border-radius (0px). 
- Focus States: Use 2px dashed #000 with a 2px outline-offset for accessibility. 
- Micro-interactions: Buttons should scale (99%) on click and invert colors (Black BG, White Text) on hover. Input labels include a status indicator dot that changes color from #D1D5DB to black on focus.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Top-aligned section (padding-top: 56px, horizontal-padding: 32px). Contains a 56x56px square logo container with a 1px solid black border. Inside the logo, place a dashed circular placeholder (#9CA3AF).

### Main Content
Scrollable central area with a 40px margin-top. Features a Title Group: h1 (text-4xl, tracking-tighter, font-bold) followed by a monospace subtitle (text-xs, uppercase, tracking-wide, Gray-500).

### Form Section
Inputs are 56px high with no rounding. Labels sit above inputs in monospace font, featuring a small 4x4px circular 'status' dot at the far right. Placeholders use Gray-300. Password inputs include a 56x56px square button on the right for 'show/hide' functionality.

### Footer
Fixed at bottom with a transparent-to-white gradient mask for scroll blending. Contains a primary CTA button (56px height, 2px border, uppercase, tracking-widest). Below the button, a centered secondary link group with an underline-offset-4 decoration on links.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Brutalist Primary Button — A high-contrast button that inverts on hover.
Height: 56px; Width: 100%; Border: 2px solid #111827; Background: #FFFFFF; Text: #111827 (font-bold, uppercase, tracking-widest, text-sm). Interaction: On hover, change background to #111827 and text to #FFFFFF. Include a right-arrow icon that translates 4px to the right on hover. Active state: scale(0.99).

### Status-Indicator Label — Technical label with focus state visualization.
Font: JetBrains Mono; Size: 12px; Case: Uppercase; Color: #6B7280. Layout: Flex-row with justify-between. Includes a 4x4px circular span at the right with background #D1D5DB. When the associated input is focused, the dot background-color transitions to #000000.

## Notas Especiais
DO: Use sharp 0px corners for all UI elements. DO: Use monospace for any utility text or labels. DO: Use high-contrast borders (2px) for primary buttons. DON'T: Use any box-shadows or drop-shadows. DON'T: Use color except for standard black/gray/white. DON'T: Use rounded corners on inputs or buttons.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Draft' or 'Technical Blueprint' aesthetic. It uses a strict monochrome color palette (#FFFFFF, #111827, #6B7280). Typography uses Satoshi for bold headings and JetBrains Mono for metadata and inputs. All components feature rounded-none (0px) corners and 1px or 2px solid borders. Hover states focus on inversion and translation rather than depth.
